title: NeuroAct: Advancing EEG Analysis and Decoding via Dual-Loop Autonomous Research

claim.summary: NeuroAct coordinates prompted Researcher, Developer and Reviewer agents that analyse EEG signals and models, implement and run decoding interventions, and distil conditional recommendations that later EEG studies reuse and revise.

tasks.source_label: Anomaly detection and diagnosis; temporal question answering; time series classification; physiological signal estimation

modules.name: Coordinator-directed specialist research cycles
modules.scope_reason: Splitting an objective into parallel questions handled by permission-separated researcher, developer and reviewer roles under a budgeted coordinator would work unchanged for non-temporal research agents.
evidence_locators: PDF p.4; passage beginning "Specialized collaboration. NeuroAct separates persona"
PDF p.5; passage beginning "Feedback redirects research. The Coordinator"

modules.name: Conditional experience distillation and revision
modules.scope_reason: Recommendations keyed to task and model conditions, then retrieved, adopted and revised from later outcomes, carry no temporal state or operation and would transfer to non-temporal research agents.
evidence_locators: PDF p.5; passage beginning "Distillation from contrasting outcomes. The"
PDF p.5; passage beginning "Revision through subsequent research. Target"

modules.name: EEG spectral and spatial signal-analysis tools
modules.scope_reason: Welch spectra, band power, Hjorth, spectral-entropy and connectivity descriptors are computed over recorded signal windows and serve analysis questions, classification, regression and model combination without redesign.
evidence_locators: PDF p.16; passage beginning "NeuroAct's EEG analysis tools provide"
PDF p.8; passage beginning "Full NeuroAct improves Workload BA"
